body: Added POST /api/v1/shankpit/queue/join, /leave, GET /status -- in-process, deliberately unpersisted FIFO queue. Once queuing players reach ShankpitQueueMinPlayers=2, everyone currently queuing is matched and given the one persistent game server's connect address (v0: that server IS the match, no per-match instances, no skill-based matching per NORTHSTAR). Matched entries expire after 2min TTL if never reconnected. SHANKPIT_SERVER_ADDR env var configures address, defaults to 127.0.0.1:6969 (play.farthq.com reserved per HQ-SPEC-INFRA-105 but not created pre-launch). 7 new tests. Live end-to-end verified: two real accounts via email auth flow, second join correctly matched both players, leave/TTL-expiry clear state, no-auth 401s. IDUNA e31db51/b2fc5a1.
title: S156-03: minimal shankpit-460 matchmaking queue
